name: Unidentified Jedi Master's Defender-class light corvette
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified Jedi Master's Defender-class light corvette
description: A Jedi Master piloted a Defender-class light corvette while leading a Galactic Republic border patrol during the Cold War, but the ship was destroyed when the patrol was lured to the Mugaar system and ambushed by Imperial forces.
